title: Canonical Decapod persistence and Dactyl routing model
intent: Advance only the Decapod-owned local persistence and concurrency semantics that can be completed before the Dactyl and Propodus contracts are available; preserve backend=local and publish a proof-backed boundary handoff.
proof_hooks: all Decapod database call sites use the canonical Dactyl model
local and cloud-facing operation contracts have backend-neutral tests
durability/concurrency invariants are enforced by Decapod schema and conditional mutations
decapod validate and required Rust tests pass
one canonical PR is published and relevant issues have status comments
backend=cloud atomic operation contract is explicit at the Decapod-Dactyl-Propodus boundary
stop_conditions: Stop at the Dactyl/Propodus operation and schema contract boundary; record exact handoff requirements instead of implementing remote behavior.
Do not claim backend=cloud atomicity until Dactyl forwards each Decapod state-plus-event mutation as one Propodus request and Neon commits it transactionally.
deferred_questions: Dactyl and Propodus adapter APIs remain external prerequisites; record the exact atomic operation contract at the boundary before remote implementation.
